prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for an existing 2D fantasy/technology pixel-art adventure game. Create one PNG sprite sheet with a truly transparent alpha background, not a drawn checkerboard. EXACTLY FOUR idle animation frames in an evenly divided 2 by 2 grid, four equal square cells, read left to right, then next row. The same SINGLE character appears full-body once in each cell, with the identical design, viewing angle, overall scale, ground baseline and horizontal centre. Leave generous transparent padding inside every cell so no extremity crosses a cell border. There are no cell borders or labels. Each frame is a subtle idle variation of the same stance, not a new pose or a different character. Frame 1 neutral, frame 2 slightly lifted/breathing, frame 3 blink or mild energy brightening, frame 4 returns towards neutral. Premium detailed 16-bit / 32-bit RPG pixel-art craftsmanship: crisp square pixel clusters, carefully drawn dark contours, rich but controlled 3 to 5 tone material shading, tiny edge highlights, weathering and intricate readable details. Match detailed small pixel-art adventurers, timber houses, mossy castles and steampunk machinery from a classic fantasy RPG. The boss should be imposing and beautifully crafted, suitable for pupils, not silly or simplified icon art. Flat orthographic frontal game sprite with a very slight view down onto the head/body, facing the viewer. No text, letters, logos, UI, numbers, ground, scenery, props or cast shadow. No vector/cartoon flat shapes, smooth gradient rendering, photorealism, blur, 3D toy rendering, or thick uniform black sticker border. Subject: KRABBOR, a massive island guardian armoured crab. Broad low oval burnt-orange and russet shell with layered bronze-gold plates, barnacle-like stone details and very restrained moss-green wear. Two huge asymmetrical articulated pincers held beside the shell, four sturdy visible pairs of articulated legs, distinct small intelligent amber eyes on short armoured stalks. Strong broad silhouette; expressive, formidable and dignified, no goofy grin or face inside the shell. Pincers, shell plates, joints and individual leg segments have intricate pixel shading. Coastal warm ochre highlights and deep brown/teal shadows; no crown or weapon. The claw tips shift only a few pixels between frames.

Subject: MECHATRON X, a towering broad-shouldered industrial robot boss from a dark technology city. Compact head with a single narrow amber/cyan visor, massive articulated arms with large mechanical hands, wide torso with a circular luminous cyan energy reactor, strong piston legs and heavy planted feet. Weathered blue-black steel armour, warm copper/brass shoulder plates and knee pads, dense small bolts, vents, visible hydraulic joints, inset pipes, layered bevelled plates, tiny cyan indicator lights. Elegant detailed retro-fantasy steampunk construction, imposing angular machine, not a cute toy and not a known franchise character. Head, body and feet remain centred and planted identically across four frames; tiny arm/piston movement, reactor pulses softly, never a new fighting pose.

Subject: NULLOX, an imposing extraterrestrial lord of the void from a crystal-covered moonbase. A tall elegant armoured humanoid, with a dark faceless helmet, two narrow glowing lilac eyes, a swept crystalline horned crown integrated into the helmet, layered angular midnight-violet and amethyst armour with pale silver-lilac edge highlights, gauntlets, a bright small diamond-shaped violet chest core, long segmented leg armour. A torn deep-purple mantle hangs behind the body. Detailed faceted shoulder crystals and engraved metallic plates. Poised almost floating a few pixels above the same invisible baseline, quiet power, not a grinning cartoon, not a known franchise villain. No independent orbiting objects outside the body. Between frames only a slight vertical hover, a few moving cloak pixels and a soft variation of the chest crystal; keep identical silhouette and scale.
